title: Spacious 2BR for Families | Close to Honky Tonks!
description:
Nashville Retreat – 2 BR Apartment Near Downtown Nashville (Sleeps 8)

Unwind in this stylish two-bedroom apartment just 8 minutes from downtown Nashville. Spend your days exploring Music City, then return to your cozy retreat designed for comfort and relaxation.

The space
This modern getaway features thoughtfully chosen amenities to make your stay as effortless as it is enjoyable.

★ LIVING ROOM ★

It is ideal for relaxing and enjoying the company of friends and family while watching a good movie or a show. 
✔ Comfortable Sofas with Pillows 
✔ Flat-Screen TV 
✔ Coffee Table 
✔ Sleeper Sofa

★ KITCHEN ★ 

The kitchen area with numerous cooking appliances and spacious countertops. If you want to take a break from the restaurants, then this is the place for you. 
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove
✔ Oven 
✔ Refrigerator/Freezer 
✔ Dishwasher 
✔ Toaster 
✔ Blender
✔ Sink - Hot & Cold Water 
✔ Trays 
✔ Glasses 
✔ Silverware 
✔ Pots & Pans

★ 2 BEDROOMS ★

The bedroom features a comfortable bed designed to provide you with the perfect resting experience. 

Bedroom 1:
✔ Queen–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

Bedroom 2:
✔ (2) Full–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - Sleeps 4)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

★ 2 BATHROOMS ★ 

The apartment features spacious full bathrooms stocked with all necessities and essential toiletries, so you don’t need to bring your own. 
✔ Mirrors 
✔ Toilet 
✔ Towels 
✔ Essential Toiletries

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with: 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning 
✔ Heating 
✔ Ceiling Fan 
✔ Washer/Dryer (in the unit)
